description: Worked example (D-14): a flat composite leaf built from the D-09 presets. The PRST leaf payload lays out, in order: a Vector (3 x f32 = x,y,z), a Quaternion (4 x f32 = w,x,y,z with w FIRST), a Matrix (3x4 row-major = 12 x f32), and a PackedRgb color (3 x u8 = r,g,b). Each composite is a Struct sub-field group — pure JSON sugar over the kernel (D-08), so byte-exactness is the kernel's, never the preset's. This is the teaching template for any flat composite-of-presets chunk. matchTagOnly so it engages on the PRST leaf at every version-FORM.
